capture_receipt.description: Emitted ONLY after a leg payload passes every wrapper validation. A refused leg emits no receipt - absence is the failure signal, never a fabricated placeholder.

chain.prev_receipt_hash: sha256 of the previous receipt's canonical form; the string 'GENESIS' bound to the manifest root digest for the first receipt
chain.receipt_hash: sha256 of this receipt's canonical form excluding this field

credits.api_usage_before: object|null, /api_usage snapshot for the execution day
credits.leg_credits: int, credits charged for this leg under the provider's accounting

fields.manifest_root_digest_sha256: root digest of capture_manifest.json the leg was executed under

provider.name: 'Twelve Data'
provider.response_timestamp_utc: string ISO, when the response was received

response.expected_rows: int|null, calendar-derived expectation for session-bound legs
response.row_delta: int|null, rows - expected_rows; nonzero is enumerated here and adjudicated by the completeness checker, never silently accepted
response.sha256: sha256 of the exact response body bytes as received

fields.window: enum W_HO | W_DEV (crypto chunks carry their window)

capture_refusal.description: NOT a receipt. A local log line recording why a leg was refused (network disabled, schema/timezone/duplicate/gap violation, truncation suspect). Refusals never enter the hash chain and never appear in the archive.

fields.reason: enum NETWORK_DISABLED | SCHEMA_VIOLATION | TIMEZONE_VIOLATION | DUPLICATE_INSTANT | GAP_VIOLATION | TRUNCATION_SUSPECT | NONFINITE_VALUE

status: CANDIDATE_NOT_ADOPTED - extends the -93 kind-discriminated receipt amendment (commit 96cd2bb); fields proven by the offline dry run in this package
